title: Substrate - Small cozy game about root and vine exploration
author: Material-Watercress1
selftext:
You start with a single seed and a patch of dirt. Most of the world is hidden, and you uncover it by choosing where your roots grow.

Underground, you’re looking for water and nutrients while finding routes around rocks and buried fossils. Small roots start as thin tendrils, and the branches supporting them get thicker as your network spreads.

The nutrients you find let you grow vines above ground, climbing trees and creeping across houses. There are glowing dew pearls to collect up there that improve things like water production and root growth.

Rain helps keep everything alive, but more roots means more water upkeep. If you spread too far without finding another supply, branches begin to shrivel. You can prune them yourself to keep a smaller network going while you explore somewhere else.

There are also ant colonies digging tunnels and carrying food through the soil, which you can zoom in and watch.

[Substrate is free to download for Windows on itch.io.](https://synyster328.itch.io/substrate)

Fully built with Codex and ElevenLabs

comments.author: Material-Watercress1
comments.body:
I'm so glad you tried it! I didn't plan to make it a big game, just the experience of balancing root growth with water management and the exploration/vine growth loop.

Was there anything about it that screams AI slop?

replies.author: StarsSpawn
replies.body: No, not really. Looks pretty good actually, with the pixel art having animations.
